sentences.text: The Star Wars sequel trilogy is the third film trilogy in the Star Wars American space opera franchise , created by George Lucas .	Star Wars	Star Wars	space opera	space opera	George Lucas	George Lucas
It is being produced by Lucasfilm Ltd. and distributed by Walt Disney Studios Motion Pictures .	Lucasfilm	Lucasfilm	Walt Disney Studios Motion Pictures	Walt Disney Studios Motion Pictures
The trilogy is to consist of episodes VII through IX and chronologically follows Return of the Jedi -LRB- 1983 -RRB- in the saga .	Return of the Jedi	Return of the Jedi
Lucas originally planned a sequel trilogy in the mid-1970s , but had abandoned these plans by the late 1990s .
The Walt Disney Company acquired Lucasfilm in late 2012 and then announced the production of a sequel trilogy .	Lucasfilm	Lucasfilm	The Walt Disney Company	The Walt Disney Company

The first installment , Star Wars : The Force Awakens , was released on December 18 , 2015 in the U.S. , following a special premiere screening in Los Angeles on December 14 .	The Force Awakens	Star Wars: The Force Awakens	Star Wars	Star Wars	Los Angeles	Los Angeles
The film is directed by J. J. Abrams who cowrote the screenplay with Lawrence Kasdan and Michael Arndt .	Lawrence Kasdan	Lawrence Kasdan	Michael Arndt	Michael Arndt	J. J. Abrams	J. J. Abrams

Harrison Ford , Mark Hamill , Carrie Fisher , and other main cast members from the original trilogy returned to reprise their roles and co-star alongside Daisy Ridley , John Boyega , Adam Driver , and Oscar Isaac .	Mark Hamill	Mark Hamill	Adam Driver	Adam Driver	Daisy Ridley	Daisy Ridley	John Boyega	John Boyega	Oscar Isaac	Oscar Isaac	Harrison Ford	Harrison Ford	Carrie Fisher	Carrie Fisher
Unlike the previous two trilogies , whose films were released approximately three years apart , the sequel films are planned to be released around two years apart .

Star Wars : The Last Jedi is set for release on December 15 , 2017 , with Rian Johnson as screenwriter and director .	Rian Johnson	Rian Johnson	The Last Jedi	Star Wars: The Last Jedi	Star Wars	Star Wars

Episode IX will be directed by Colin Trevorrow and written by Trevorrow and Derek Connolly , and is scheduled to be released on May 24 , 2019 .	Colin Trevorrow	Colin Trevorrow	Derek Connolly	Derek Connolly	Episode IX	Star Wars: Episode IX
